follow-up time: Through delivery and the early neonatal period
cohort: Pregnant women in their third trimester with singleton pregnancies
finding: The borderline AFI group had significantly higher rates of preterm delivery, meconium-stained liquor, cesarean section, and adverse perinatal outcomes including low Apgar score, respiratory distress syndrome, neonatal intensive care unit admission, intrauterine growth restriction, and low birth weight.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rate was significantly higher in the borderline AFI group.
